route.instructions: Which consumer service should receive this Solace event? Prefer schema, event_type, and payload meaning over a conflicting legacy topic.

criteria.order-processing: order creation, amendment, cancellation, or validation
criteria.payment-operations: payment authorization, settlement, failure, refund, or reconciliation
criteria.logistics: shipment, carrier, delivery, customs, or fulfilment movement
criteria.inventory-management: warehouse stock reservation, count, replenishment, or correction
criteria.customer-support: customer ticket, complaint, service request, or human follow-up
criteria.fraud-review: suspected fraud, account takeover, payment abuse, or security alert
